sentences.text: In 2024, the influence index stands at 31.6 for China (band 24.2–56.2, from 3 of six components) and 49.3 for the United States (band 42.2–74.6, from 4 of six components). The net lean is -17.7 points toward the United States.
Over the five years to 2024, the index for China rose by 6.1 points and the index for the United States rose by 3.8 points.

The value for China rests on trade export share, trade import share and diplomatic alignment; every component is a recorded tie (trade shares, finance, debt, UN votes, legislative stance), not a judgement.

The value for the United States rests on trade export share, trade import share, finance flow and diplomatic alignment; every component is a recorded tie (trade shares, finance, debt, UN votes, legislative stance), not a judgement.
In 2024, 0.0% of Costa Rica's mineral exports (UN Comtrade value US$40 m) went to China and 99% to the United States; together 99%, the rest to other destinations.
Since 2019 the share going to China was broadly flat and the share going to the United States was broadly flat.
Relative to the 20-country export basket, its exports are specialised in rare earths (RCA 16.3), gold (RCA 5.3) and phosphate potash (RCA 2.4).
The AidData records show US$893 m of documented commitments from Chinese institutions to Costa Rica over 2007–2021 (29 events; the source ends in 2021).
The DFC and EXIM records show US$336 m of documented commitments from US institutions to Costa Rica over 2007–2026 (229 events).

The lenders with the largest recorded commitments to named recipients here are China Development Bank (CDB) (US$940 m), Export-Import Bank of China (China Eximbank) (US$528 m) and China Ministry of Commerce (US$282 m).
In the UN General Assembly, voting agreement in 2024 was 75% with China and 44% with the United States.
Since 2019, agreement with China fell by 9.4 points and agreement with the United States rose by 19.0 points.
Too few mineral-related legislative records naming either actor have been scored for a stance series (five per year are needed); the text model is zero-shot baseline, not yet validated.

After Executive Order 13817: A Federal Strategy to Ensure Secure and Reliable Supplies of Critical Minerals (2017-12), the share of exports to the United States moved -3.1 points (99% before, 96% after); placebo p 0.63 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

After China: export controls on graphite items in force (Announcement 2023 No. 39 of 20 October 2023) (2023-12), the share of exports to the United States moved +1.2 points (98% before, 99% after); placebo p 0.91 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

After China: export controls on gallium and germanium items in force (MOFCOM/GAC Announcement 2023 No. 23 of 3 July 2023) (2023-08), the share of exports to the United States moved +1.2 points (98% before, 99% after); placebo p 0.91 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

The published forecast for the share of mineral exports going to the United States in 2030 is 99% (90% band 35%–100%), from naive persistence, because no model beat it in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

The published forecast for the influence index of China in 2030 is 33.9 (90% band 24.4–45.2), from random walk with drift partially pooled across countries (empirical Bayes), which beat naive persistence by 1% CRPS in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

The published forecast for the influence index of the United States in 2030 is 49.2 (90% band 27.4–70.8), from damped local linear trend (Kalman filter, maximum likelihood), which beat naive persistence by 2% CRPS in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

In 2025, unavailable components: trade export share and trade import share (no reported trade for the year); legislative stance (no scored legislative records naming the actor); debt stock (no source for debt owed to the United States); finance flow (source coverage ends 2021); debt stock and diplomatic alignment (source coverage ends 2024).

Source coverage ends at different years: Chinese official finance to 2021, US finance to 2026, debt by creditor to 2024, UN votes to 2024 and trade to 2025; components beyond a source's coverage are unavailable, not zero.
12 of the dated events used above are still in the draft event list awaiting the project owner's review.
Stance values come from the text model (zero-shot baseline, not yet validated); the rest of this brief rests on official statistics and the registered databases, each cited on its chart.
